findings.source_quote: δοκεῖ σοι, φησί, ταῦτα ἀγαθὰ εἶναι;
findings.english_quote: “Do these seem to you to be good?”
findings.issue: Paragraph 11 omits φησί, the source’s explicit attribution of this question to the shepherd. The surrounding dialogue makes the speaker inferable, but the supplied standard text does not preserve this attribution clause.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction for fresh review: “Do these seem to you to be good?” he says.

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all twelve paragraphs of the supplied working Greek. The standard edition needs one minor restoration of explicit speaker attribution; no concrete fidelity defect was found in the simplified edition. Both preserve the good/evil contrast, necessity and negation, salvation wording, practical-service list, and both concluding conditions. Reader-facing servant follows current policy. The notes distinguish editorial supplements and corrections from preserved wording and disclose the stated substantive alternatives without replacing the selected working readings. This review does not independently verify the cited scans, manuscript readings, or exhaustive collation; proposed wording remains subject to fresh review.
